observable_behavior: Given a map, chart or monitoring summary, states correctly what was measured, the unit, the spatial and temporal extent and resolution, and the data source; names at least two things the product cannot show.
evidence_of_performance: Short written interpretation of 2-3 unfamiliar data products scored against a key
assessment_method: Work-sample test (30 min, scored rubric)
notes: Universal (Tier DC-1). Target level for all staff, including field and administrative roles.

observable_behavior: Detects planted problems in a data product (mismatched baselines, truncated axis, unrepresentative sample, scale mismatch between data and decision, missing-data handling) and explains how each would change the conclusion.
evidence_of_performance: Annotated critique of a flawed briefing product
assessment_method: Work-sample test with seeded errors; inter-rater scoring

observable_behavior: Reviews colleagues' data products before release and returns specific, actionable corrections; writes the 'limitations' section of products used for decisions.
evidence_of_performance: Review comments and limitations sections in released products
assessment_method: Portfolio review by two assessors

observable_behavior: Sets organizational standards for how data products state sources, resolution and limits, and audits compliance across a program.
evidence_of_performance: Published product standard; audit results
assessment_method: Document review plus structured interview

observable_behavior: Before using an AI tool for a task, checks whether the tool is approved for that data class; withholds sensitive or controlled information from unapproved tools; checks every factual claim or citation in an AI output against a source before using it; labels AI-assisted content where required.
evidence_of_performance: Task log from a scenario exercise showing data-handling decisions, checks performed and disclosure
assessment_method: Scenario simulation (e.g., draft a site summary with an assistant; scenario contains a sensitive location and a fabricated citation)
notes: Universal (Tier DC-1). Maps to DOL TEN 07-25 content areas 'evaluating AI outputs' and 'managing AI responsibly' (DC-016). Must be tool-agnostic: the exercise can run on whatever assistant the organization uses.

observable_behavior: Chooses when not to use AI (e.g., where errors are costly and checking costs more than doing); gives the tool sufficient context; detects omissions as well as errors; records the prompt/version/output when the result enters a work product.
evidence_of_performance: Work product with an AI-use note (tool, version, purpose, checks, changes made)
assessment_method: Portfolio review of 3 work products; spot audit

observable_behavior: Coaches a team on safe use; writes task-specific guidance (what AI may and may not be used for in a given workflow, with examples of failures seen locally).
evidence_of_performance: Team guidance document with local failure examples
assessment_method: Document review; observation of coaching

observable_behavior: Sets organizational AI-use policy and literacy requirements by role, and measures whether staff meet them (not only whether training was completed).
evidence_of_performance: Role-based AI-use policy; literacy assessment results
assessment_method: Document review plus interview with policy owner
notes: EU Art. 4 now requires 'measures' rather than a guaranteed level (DC-017); this anchor asks for measurement anyway.

observable_behavior: Records, for own data and outputs, source, date, version, method and any AI tool used, using the organization's template, so that a colleague can find the inputs.
evidence_of_performance: Completed provenance record for a field dataset or analysis
assessment_method: Work-product audit (can a second person locate every input from the record?)

observable_behavior: Builds a lineage record for a derived product (inputs -> transformations -> model/AI steps with versions -> human review -> output) and can reproduce or explain any figure in it on request.
evidence_of_performance: Lineage diagram/record attached to a report or dataset
assessment_method: Trace test: assessor picks three numbers in a product; candidate traces each to source within a set time
notes: CEQ data standard v1.2 'data_record_version' and record-origin fields are a concrete model (DC-034).

observable_behavior: Designs provenance capture into a pipeline or program (automatic logging of versions, prompts and reviewers) and corrects a downstream product when an upstream error is found.
evidence_of_performance: Pipeline design with provenance fields; documented correction notice
assessment_method: Design review by peer; review of an incident/correction file

observable_behavior: Sets provenance requirements across an organization or partnership, including for vendor and AI-generated content entering administrative records, and audits them.
evidence_of_performance: Provenance policy; audit findings; contract clauses
assessment_method: Document review; structured interview
notes: In 2024 only 37% of USDA AI use cases reported complete or widely available training-data documentation (DC-002).

observable_behavior: Recognizes sensitive content in own data (rare-species locations, archaeological/cultural sites, Tribal information, personal data) and applies the organization's withholding or generalization rule before sharing.
evidence_of_performance: Shared dataset or map with correct withholding
assessment_method: Scenario test with a mixed dataset containing sensitive items
notes: Cultural-resource and Tribal information rules are owned by SC/TN; this anchors the technical act.

observable_behavior: Makes and documents a sensitivity determination (reason, category, generalization level, review date), generalizes only the distributed copy, replaces withheld fields with explanatory wording, and checks derived products (summaries, model outputs, figures) for leakage.
evidence_of_performance: Sensitivity determination record; released copy vs stored record
assessment_method: Work-sample test scored against GBIF practices (DC-029)
notes: GBIF: document reason and review date; restrict distributed copy only; never alter stored record (DC-029).

observable_behavior: Assesses leakage risk in AI and analytics workflows (training sets, embeddings, retrieval corpora, high-resolution model outputs), designs access controls, and negotiates data-sharing terms with data holders.
evidence_of_performance: Risk assessment for an AI/analytics workflow; data-sharing agreement
assessment_method: Design review; structured interview with a data-holder partner (where the partner agrees)
notes: Co-design with TN for Indigenous data; CARE (DC-050).

observable_behavior: Sets organizational sensitive-data policy, including review cycles and hold-back registers, and accounts to data holders for compliance.
evidence_of_performance: Policy; hold-back register; review-cycle records
assessment_method: Document review; partner feedback
notes: OpenLMP hold-back register is a working pattern (DC-036).

observable_behavior: Before using a model output, states the model's intended purpose, input data period and area, and whether the current use falls inside them; flags uses outside that envelope.
evidence_of_performance: Completed fitness-for-use checklist for a model output
assessment_method: Scenario test with in- and out-of-envelope uses

observable_behavior: Designs and runs an independent validation (spatially or temporally blocked hold-out or field reference data), reports error by condition (e.g., ecosystem type, season, disturbance class) and identifies where the model should not be used.
evidence_of_performance: Validation report with stratified error and stated domain of applicability
assessment_method: Work-sample: validate a provided model on a provided dataset; scored rubric
notes: Durable practice in EPA 2009 model guidance (DC-051; not re-read).

observable_behavior: Conducts sensitivity and uncertainty analysis, tests performance under novel (non-analog) conditions, and provides effective challenge to another team's model.
evidence_of_performance: Model evaluation memo including challenge findings
assessment_method: Peer review of an evaluation memo; panel interview
notes: NOAA inventory shows predictability deteriorates under novel conditions (DC-001).

observable_behavior: Sets validation standards proportional to decision consequence for an organization's model portfolio and decides when models are retired.
evidence_of_performance: Validation standard; retirement decisions with rationale
assessment_method: Document review; structured interview
notes: Links to DC-CAND-19.

observable_behavior: Reports results with the uncertainty provided by the method or tool (interval, confidence class, detection probability) and does not drop it when summarizing.
evidence_of_performance: Summary or briefing slide that retains uncertainty
assessment_method: Work-product review

observable_behavior: Identifies the main sources of uncertainty in an analysis (measurement, sampling, model, scenario, AI error), quantifies at least the dominant ones, and states what result would change the recommendation.
evidence_of_performance: Analysis with an uncertainty section and a 'what would change this' statement
assessment_method: Work-sample test; rubric
notes: FBAN/LTAN standards require communicating uncertainty and confidence (DC-047).

observable_behavior: Translates uncertainty for an authorizing official in decision terms (risk of a wrong call, value of more information), tests the communication with the audience, and holds the caveat under pressure to simplify.
evidence_of_performance: Decision brief; record of audience test; documented disagreement where caveats were contested
assessment_method: Observed briefing (live or recorded) scored by two assessors
notes: SC secondary.

observable_behavior: Sets organizational conventions for uncertainty language and visuals and evaluates whether decision-makers interpret them correctly.
evidence_of_performance: Conventions guide; comprehension test results
assessment_method: Document review plus evaluation data

observable_behavior: Checks an AI output (species ID, classification, summary, draft) against the source or field evidence using a checklist, corrects or rejects errors, and records what was checked.
evidence_of_performance: Validation checklist with corrections
assessment_method: Work-sample test with seeded errors (incl. a hallucinated citation and an ecologically implausible ID)
notes: Derived from v1 7.2.1 Foundational (DC-045), made observable.

observable_behavior: Validates outputs across the types met in own work, including omissions and out-of-scope answers; for high-volume outputs, draws and reviews a defined sample and estimates the error rate.
evidence_of_performance: Validation record with sample design and estimated error rate
assessment_method: Work-sample: validate a batch of 200 AI detections or comment codes; score accuracy of the error estimate
notes: FWS DocketScope: 'Results are verified by analysts during comment review' (DC-001).

observable_behavior: Designs validation protocols for a workflow (what to check, how much, by whom), leads validation of novel or high-stakes uses, and explains to decision-makers the confidence the validation supports.
evidence_of_performance: Validation protocol; validation summary for a decision-maker
assessment_method: Design review plus structured interview
notes: FC secondary for ecological outputs.

observable_behavior: Sets organizational or sector validation standards for AI-assisted environmental analysis and reviews them against observed failures.
evidence_of_performance: Standard; failure log analysis
assessment_method: Document review

observable_behavior: Follows the review steps defined for an AI-assisted workflow and escalates outputs that meet escalation criteria; does not approve outputs not actually reviewed.
evidence_of_performance: Review log showing reviewed items and escalations
assessment_method: Observation or audit of review logs (sampled)

observable_behavior: For a workflow, specifies review rates by risk, confidence thresholds, escalation triggers and reviewer qualifications, and shows the reviewer can change the outcome.
evidence_of_performance: Workflow review specification
assessment_method: Design work-sample scored against a rubric

observable_behavior: Measures whether review is substantive (override rates, time-on-item, seeded-error catch rate) and redesigns when review degrades into rubber-stamping; keeps reviewers independent of the tool's producer.
evidence_of_performance: Review-quality metrics; redesign record
assessment_method: Audit with seeded errors; panel review of metrics
notes: 'Presumed high-impact but not high-impact' designations rest on human review being the principal basis (DC-001).

observable_behavior: Sets organizational requirements for human oversight by risk tier and reports oversight performance to governance bodies.
evidence_of_performance: Oversight requirements; governance reports
assessment_method: Document review; interview
notes: Authorization of the design is SC (v1 7.1.4).

observable_behavior: Labels items for a reference set following written guidelines without seeing tool outputs, and flags ambiguous items.
evidence_of_performance: Labeled items with ambiguity flags
assessment_method: Agreement with expert labels on a check subset
notes: OpenLMP gold set: blind annotation (DC-037).

observable_behavior: Builds a representative reference set for a task (sampling frame, labeling guide, double-labeling of a subset, agreement statistic) and computes precision/recall or equivalent for a tool against it.
evidence_of_performance: Evaluation report with agreement and performance metrics
assessment_method: Work-sample: build and score a small evaluation set
notes: OpenLMP: kappa 0.939 on doubly annotated pages (DC-037).

observable_behavior: Compares candidate tools and the current human process on the same set, reports error by subgroup or condition, tests LLM-judge scoring against human scoring before relying on it, and recommends adopt/limit/reject.
evidence_of_performance: Comparative evaluation memo with recommendation
assessment_method: Peer review; structured interview
notes: DraftNEPABench uses LLM judges against SME rubrics (DC-032) - judges need human validation.

observable_behavior: Establishes an organizational evaluation program (shared reference sets, re-testing after model updates, publication of results) and requires local evaluation before adoption or procurement.
evidence_of_performance: Evaluation program charter; re-test records
assessment_method: Document review

observable_behavior: Uses an approved tool to extract or summarize content from a plan, permit or comment set and verifies each extracted statement against the cited passage.
evidence_of_performance: Extraction table with source page/paragraph for each row and verification marks
assessment_method: Work-sample with seeded misattributions

observable_behavior: Designs an extraction or coding scheme, runs it over a document set, measures omission and fabrication rates on a sample, and documents limits for the responsible official.
evidence_of_performance: Coded dataset; error-rate memo
assessment_method: Work-sample scored against a gold set
notes: Deployed: USFS plan review, FWS DocketScope; pilots at EPA, BLM, NOAA (DC-001).

observable_behavior: Builds a reusable pipeline (schema, prompts or models, retrieval, citation tracing, evaluation) whose outputs can enter an administrative record, and maintains it through model changes.
evidence_of_performance: Pipeline documentation; evaluation results across model versions
assessment_method: Design review; re-run test after model swap
notes: SC secondary: legal sufficiency stays with the official.

observable_behavior: Sets organizational rules for when LLM-derived analyses may enter decision documents and how they are disclosed and audited.
evidence_of_performance: Policy; audit results
assessment_method: Document review; interview

observable_behavior: Runs an approved agent on a bounded task, reads its action log, and stops it when it acts outside the task.
evidence_of_performance: Annotated action log
assessment_method: Scenario simulation with an agent that drifts out of scope
notes: Emergent (evidence label S). Re-anchor after the 2026 inventory.

observable_behavior: Scopes a multi-step task for an agent (inputs, permitted tools, stop conditions, checkpoints), verifies intermediate products and final result, and records responsibility.
evidence_of_performance: Task specification and verification record
assessment_method: Work-sample in sandbox
notes: Coding agents on DraftNEPABench (DC-032).

observable_behavior: Designs agent workflows for a team with least-privilege permissions, audit logging, and failure-recovery steps; tests for silent failure.
evidence_of_performance: Workflow design; failure tests
assessment_method: Design review; red-team exercise

observable_behavior: Sets organizational conditions under which agents may act on systems or records and reviews incidents.
evidence_of_performance: Policy; incident reviews
assessment_method: Document review

observable_behavior: Identifies when a model or AI output they use feeds a consequential decision (payment, permit, enforcement, safety, cultural resources) and checks that it is on the organization's inventory with an assigned owner.
evidence_of_performance: Inventory check record
assessment_method: Scenario test

observable_behavior: Completes a model/AI risk assessment for a use (purpose, consequence, failure modes, affected parties, validation status, monitoring plan) and proposes a risk tier.
evidence_of_performance: Risk assessment form
assessment_method: Work-sample scored against a rubric
notes: M-25-21 high-impact definition and minimum practices (DC-007).

observable_behavior: Provides independent challenge to a model owner, sets monitoring and re-validation triggers (data drift, model update, new use), and recommends pause or retirement when criteria are not met.
evidence_of_performance: Challenge memo; monitoring plan; pause/retire recommendation
assessment_method: Peer review; panel interview
notes: SR 11-7 'effective challenge' as cross-sector precedent (DC-059; not re-read).

observable_behavior: Runs a model-risk program across a portfolio (inventory, tiering, independent validation, reporting to governance) and is accountable for its results.
evidence_of_performance: Program charter; portfolio report
assessment_method: Document review; interview
notes: USDA FPAC satellite crop-verification models are the environmental high-impact archetype (DC-001).
